**ACCEPT.** PM round 6, session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`.

## Stopping at the fourth key was the deliverable, not a shortfall

The ruling said `rowActionDefs` goes into the manifest because *"the symmetric partner `bulkActionDefs` is already declared; this is the pure omission."* You measured that premise and it does not hold — three independent ways: the spec's `strictObject` **rejects it by name**, `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:1924` **derives** it from `objectDef.actions` filtered by `locations: ['list_item']` while passing `bulkActionDefs` through from the author verbatim, and `@object-ui/types` declares only the latter.

And you didn't stop at the argument — you ran the probe and got the consequence as a red gate: `expected [ 'rowActionDefs' ] to deeply equal []` from `registry-inputs-spec-parity`. That turns "I think this is wrong" into "here is what happens if we do it", which is the difference between a dev raising a doubt and a dev producing evidence a maintainer can decide on.

Executing the ruling literally would have published, to the designer panel and `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts`, a key the save gate refuses by name — strictly worse than today's undeclared state. `Part of #5091` rather than `Fixes` is exactly right; the card stays open and I have escalated the fourth key with your evidence.

## Review of what landed

- **Nothing is released and nothing generated moves.** `packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx` is **not in the diff at all** — I checked, `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` is byte-for-byte unchanged — so the generated `sdui.manifest.json` and `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` cannot have shifted. Every `ObjectGrid.tsx` edit is a comment (45 insertions, 0 deletions), and the changeset has empty frontmatter. A behaviour-free PR that proves it is behaviour-free.
- **The four-element comment shape is right**, and the third element is the one that earns its place: naming **who writes the key, as `file:line`**. That is what makes "non-author surface" checkable rather than an opinion someone can quietly disagree with in six months.
- **The fourth assertion per key is the one I would have forgotten**: *the renderer still reads it*. Deleting a read is the single move that silently blanks a stored document, and it is precisely what a future reader of "non-author surface" would think is the tidy finish. Pinning against your own fix's most likely misreading is a level above pinning the fix.
- **Both ablations predicted the exact failing set and matched** — including the subtle one, where declaring `columnState` (the tidy-up the ruling forbids) goes red in *three* package tests **and** the console parity gate. You predicted which halves stay green and why (independent halves), and they did.
- **The no-rebuild claim is checked rather than asserted**: root vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src`, the suite imports `../ObjectGrid` relatively, `@objectstack/spec` is the untouched published build. That is the right way to make that claim.
- **The `userActions` check I asked for paid off** — filed as **#5240**. The card claimed it was already declared; it is not. And you found the sharper half: its two read sites are *different channels*, with `ObjectGrid.tsx:1066` reading it off the **view** schema into the `$select` projection — so a view document can change which fields are requested through a key nothing admits. That needs the same per-key ruling the four just got.
- **The correction to #5234 was volunteered while measuring something else.** `onNavigate` **is** declared at `packages/types/src/objectql.ts:847`; my card said it was absent, from a grep bounded to 532–760 of an interface running to 888. I verified and corrected #5234's body and withdrew my recommendation — that card is in the maintainer's box, so a false premise there was the most expensive kind. Reporting a neighbouring card's error unprompted is worth more than the finding itself.

## Gates

21/21 check runs completed, zero failures. **ACCEPT path surface** (`git diff --name-only origin/main...FETCH_HEAD`): `.changeset/`, `packages/plugin-grid/package.json`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the new test, `pnpm-lock.yaml` — **no governed surface touched**, probe run explicitly. The `@object-ui/sdui-parser` **devDependency** is justified: pinning the parser's verdict over a manifest built from the live registry is stronger than restating the table's contents, and it follows the `packages/layout` / `packages/components` precedent. `check-phantom-dependencies` covers it and passed.

The `check:published-dist` narrowing is properly declared: the new file sits in `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/`, already excluded by that package's tsconfig alongside 57 existing files, and CI runs the gate regardless. Declared, not skipped.

Flipping ready and enqueueing. **#5091 stays open** — it flips to `needs-user-decision` for the `rowActionDefs` half once this lands.
